sfx_review.label: chime
sfx_review.note: Bright tonal onset with stacked harmonics ~440 ms before the window appears; matches the line 'You hear that?' as the agent's arrival cue.

pattern.description: A translucent glass UI window composited into live-action footage: the green header bar appears first, the body expands downward, the sparkle icon pops in, then an inner frosted card scales up inside it.
pattern.why_premium: Glassmorphic UI placed in the real office (with background showing through) makes the AI agent feel present in the room; the header-then-body-then-content order reads as a deliberate, staged reveal.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(win, {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.92, clipPath: 'inset(0 0 80% 0 round 16px)'}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0% 0 round 16px)', duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}).fromTo(icon, {scale: 0}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: 'back.out(2)'}, '-=0.05').fromTo(card, {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.85}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}, '-=0.1'); backdrop-filter blur on win and card.
build_hint.remotion: Window: opacity/scale via interpolate(frame, [0, 7], ...) with Easing.out(Easing.cubic) and a clip-path inset driven downward; icon: spring({frame: frame - 5, fps, config: {damping: 12, stiffness: 200}}); card: spring({frame: frame - 9, fps, config: {damping: 20, stiffness: 170}}) for scale 0.85 to 1 plus opacity.

notes: b02 OCR text 'Xx' is a misread of the sparkle glyph, so is_text is false. b01 stops at y~461 while the window's faint lower body extends to ~510 on the end frame. Order of header vs body reveal is from the filmstrip only; code should measure.
